reviewCharts.warning: North Carolina native review rows use official precinct/reporting-unit presidential vote-share screening and presidential-versus-Governor same-party drop-off screening. The comparison contest is Governor, not U.S. Senate, because North Carolina did not have a 2024 U.S. Senate race. The NCSBE file includes non-real precinct reporting units such as early voting, absentee, provisional, and transfer rows.
